verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Here I stand
Forever in Your mighty hand

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Living with Your promise
Written on my heart

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I am yours
Surrendered wholly to You

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
You set me in Your family
Calling me Your own

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Now I, I belong to You
Lord i need

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Your Spirit, Your Word, Your Truth
Hear my cry

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
My deep desire
To know You more

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
In Your name
I will lift my hands

verse.name: c1e
verse.lines:
To the King
This anthem of praise I bring

verse.name: c1f
verse.lines:
Heaven knows
I long to love You

verse.name: c1g
verse.lines:
With all I am
I belong to You
